summary.headline: No clear edges; PLTR earnings Nov 2 and VLO diesel export ban risk top holdings watch
summary.summary: Nothing decisive today; most reads are low-conviction. Biggest threats to holdings: PLTR faces a binary earnings print Nov 2 amid a Burry short headline and a short-volume spike, and VLO carries a possible US diesel export ban despite a reported Oct 22 beat. MPC reports Nov 3 with a Raymond James target raise as a modest positive. Among candidates, PANW jumped about 7% on unexplained news with 64% short-volume share, so it is not a clean breakout. TXN filed a 424B5 offering on Oct 26, a possible dilution flag. FTNT reports Q3 after a run-up, and LLY short volume fell to 37% versus a 48% average, but neither is a confirmed edge.
actions: Decide PLTR sizing or hedge before the Nov 2 earnings print; the setup is binary.
Check diesel export ban news and the details of VLO's Oct 22 print for thesis risk.
Pull TXN's 424B5 to see offering size and use of proceeds before considering entry.
